 Atlanta United FC and Toronto FC meet in round 33 of the 2026 Major League Soccer season this Sunday, 1 November, with kick-off at 21:30 UK time at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta.
 Atlanta are desperate to end a poor run of results, having lost three consecutive league matches. Toronto arrive in better form, with three wins in their last six games, although their away record remains a concern.
 The head-to-head record suggests a competitive encounter, but Atlanta’s defensive problems could allow the visitors to take all three points.

 Atlanta United FC vs. Toronto FC - Head-to-head record
 The recent head-to-head record points to a closely contested fixture . Across their last 10 meetings, Atlanta United FC have recorded three wins, Toronto FC have won twice, and five matches have ended in draws.
 Atlanta have also enjoyed a degree of home advantage in this matchup. In the last 10 meetings between the sides at Atlanta’s stadium, the hosts have won four times, while five games ended level and Toronto claimed one victory.
 Atlanta won the most recent meeting, beating Toronto 2-1 away in April 2026, with Aleksey Miranchuk and Tristan Muyumba contributing to the victory. However, the hosts’ current home form offers little reassurance ahead of this rematch.

 Atlanta United FC - In desperate need of points
 Let’s take a closer look at Atlanta United FC’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s momentum and their recent displays to see how they approach this Atlanta United FC vs Toronto FC fixture.
 Recent form
 Atlanta United FC sit 14th in the Eastern Conference after a difficult campaign, with eight wins and 18 defeats from 32 league matches. Their home form has been particularly poor : they have lost 10 of their 16 matches at Mercedes-Benz Stadium.
 The hosts arrive on a three-game losing streak, beaten 2-1 by New York City FC, 3-2 by Chicago Fire and 3-1 by Inter Miami. They have conceded eight goals across those matches, underlining the defensive problems that have undermined their season.
 Atlanta have managed just one win in their last six MLS fixtures, alongside one draw and four defeats. Their recent home record is even more worrying, with three consecutive defeats in which they conceded at least three goals.
 Aleksey Miranchuk and Miguel Almirón have each scored six league goals this season and will be important to Atlanta’s hopes of turning things around.

 Toronto FC - Looking to build on win
 Now, let’s turn our attention to Toronto FC. We’ll examine their recent form, key players, and what to expect from them in this upcoming match.
 Recent form
 Toronto FC sit 10th in the Eastern Conference and have shown greater consistency than their opponents. They have collected three wins from their last six league matches, averaging 1.83 goals per game over that period.
 The visitors head to Atlanta after a 2-1 victory over DC United. Before that, they suffered a 4-2 defeat against Columbus Crew but had recorded a convincing 2-0 away win over New York Red Bulls.
 Away from home, however, Toronto have struggled to find consistency. They have gone without a win in 10 of their last 12 away matches , so their victory over New York Red Bulls offers encouragement rather than proof that their travel problems are behind them.
 Toronto will be without Henry Wingo and Nelson Palacio because of injuries. Despite those absences, much of their regular starting lineup remains available, and they have a chance to exploit Atlanta’s poor defensive form.

 Predictions for Atlanta United FC vs. Toronto FC - A decisive result expected
 Atlanta United FC’s defence has been struggling, conceding eight goals in their last three games. Given Toronto FC’s attacking talent, there is a strong possibility that both teams will find the back of the net .
 Both sides have poor records on their respective home and away form, making a winner difficult to predict. With goals expected, a lively start could see the match have over 1.5 goals in the first half .
 Considering the defensive vulnerabilities and attacking potential on display, picking an outright winner is risky. Therefore, our main prediction is for a decisive result, with the Double Chance – 12 market covering a win for either team.
